stem:
Sohail wants butter from curd. He uses a churner to agitate the curd until fatty lumps separate from the liquid.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: Churning is a suitable method to obtain butter (or cream) from such milk products.
The fatty lumps obtained by churning curd are buttermilk.
Churning can separate dissolved salt from salt water the same way.
Butter separates from curd only if the mixture is left completely still.

teacher.key_rationale: Churning agitates milk products so butter or cream separates. The fatty lumps are butter, not buttermilk. Dissolved salt does not separate by churning, and stillness is the opposite of churning.
